articles.summary: LOS ANGELES, April 8, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) – AXIL Brands, Inc. (“AXIL” or the “Company”) (NYSE American: AXIL), an emerging global consumer products company for AXIL® hearing protection and enhancement products and Reviv3® hair and skin care products, announces financial and operational results for the third quarter ended February 28, 2025 (3Q25).
articles.title: AXIL Brands Reports Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2025 Financial Results
